note: Annual cost = (tradeCount / elapsedYears) × ibkrCostPerRt. All figures in EUR unless noted.

components.label: EURUSD 30M (E0, all trades)
components.reason: 4,266 trades × €4.10/rt = €944/yr cost drag at 1c. At €15k capital that is 6.3%/yr — economically unsustainable without gross edge >8%. E0 (unfiltered) fails cost hurdle for retail IBKR pricing.

components.label: EURUSD 30M (E6_MonLong — Monday + Long only)
components.reason: 415 trades = €91.89/yr cost drag at €15k = 0.61%. WF: 9/9 folds positive. OOS CAGR 19.27%. Cost-stress ×1.5 still positive. This is the confirmed ex-ante viable baseline filter.

components.label: DAX 1H (D1_Baseline)
components.reason: 1,307 trades at €0.76/rt = €53.63/yr. FDXS is the cheapest confirmed IBKR instrument in the portfolio. 9/9 WF folds positive.

components.label: DAX 2H (D2_HighVolYears)
components.reason: 1,629 trades (HighVolYears filter) at €0.76/rt = €66.85/yr. Filter concentrates on high-volatility years where edge is highest. WF: 9/9 positive.

components.label: Gold Thursday Long (GLD_BestMonths)
components.reason: 318 trades (BestMonths filter) at €2.63/rt = €45.16/yr. Low trade count is by design — seasonal months only. WF: 9/9 positive.

components.label: YM1 TAT (Dow trend-and-trade)
components.reason: 573 trades over 18.52yr. No PB variant data in repo. Requires Brain backtest for WF validation. MYM margin estimated at ~$600 (~€490).

components.label: SPY Seasonal (S&P 500 seasonal)
components.reason: Estimated ~3 trades/yr based on typical S&P seasonal entry windows. No backtest data in repo. 56 estimated trades insufficient for robust WF without Brain data.

components.label: ZM1 Seasonal (Soybean Meal seasonal)
components.reason: Estimated 2 trades/yr. No repo backtest. MZM micro availability on IBKR needs confirmation.

components.label: Sugar Seasonal (SB seasonal long)
components.reason: SB (Sugar #11) has relatively high exchange fees vs micros. No SB micro equivalent. €5/rt estimate. Illiquid sessions carry fill risk.

components.label: EEM Seasonal (MSCI EM seasonal)
components.reason: No liquid US-listed futures for MSCI EM at retail. CME EMF delisted 2019. SGX accessible via IBKR but needs non-standard setup. Excluded from portfolio until resolved.

components.label: Copper Seasonal (HG seasonal)
components.reason: MHG (Micro HG Copper). High margin relative to capital at €15k. No repo backtest.

components.label: Gold Seasonal (GC1 seasonal)
components.reason: Same instrument as GLD component (MGC). Second MGC contract needed if GLD_BestMonths signal is simultaneously active. Low cost per trade, but no seasonal backtest in repo.

components.label: Crude Oil Seasonal (CL seasonal)
components.reason: MCL (Micro WTI Crude). Reasonable cost and margin. Crude oil is highly sensitive to geopolitical events which can overwhelm seasonal patterns. No repo backtest.

components.label: Corn Seasonal (ZC seasonal)
components.reason: MZC (Micro Corn). 3 entry windows per year estimated (spring planting, summer drought, harvest). No repo backtest.

components.label: Wheat Seasonal (ZW seasonal)
components.reason: MZW (Micro Wheat). ZW standard confirmed cost €4.92/rt; MZW micro estimated €2.00/rt. 37 estimated trades. LOW_SAMPLE (insufficient for parameter stability). No repo backtest.

components.label: Soybean Seasonal (ZS seasonal)
components.reason: MZS (Micro Soybean). 3 windows estimated. No repo backtest.

components.label: Cocoa Seasonal (CC seasonal)
components.reason: CC (Cocoa) — no micro contract. Higher exchange fees. Thin liquidity in off-hours. €1,470 margin is high relative to €15k capital. No repo backtest.

components.label: IWM Seasonal (Russell 2000 seasonal)
components.reason: M2K (Micro E-mini Russell 2000) is confirmed liquid and accessible. Instrument is SOLVABLE. Seasonal signal definition needed from Brain before backtest can run.
